node.statement: Let theta:=sup||Dp_V-I||, made <=1/4 by node 1.1. For two points z,z' in any convex coordinate box, the fundamental theorem of calculus gives ||p_V(z)-p_V(z')-(z-z')||<=theta||z-z'||; hence p_V is injective and bi-Lipschitz there. Also Dp_V=I+(Dp_V-I) is invertible by the convergent Neumann series, with inverse norm <=(1-theta)^{-1}; the finite-dimensional C^1 inverse-function argument therefore makes p_V a C^1 local diffeomorphism (and a C^1 diffeomorphism onto its image). This uses only node 1.1.2 and elementary integration of a C^1 map along a line segment.
